# Emil Krebs

> Emil Krebs is a software engineer at TypeFox GmbH in Kiel, Germany.
> He builds frontends, domain-specific languages (DSLs), and IDEs in
> TypeScript and Kotlin, and contributes to Eclipse Langium.

## Pages
- [Home](https://emilkrebs.dev/): profile, work, and projects
- [Story](https://emilkrebs.dev/story/): background in software and developer tooling
- [Healthstack](https://emilkrebs.dev/healthstack/): private IDE dev build with a public DSL playground
- [中文](https://emilkrebs.dev/zh/): Chinese-language home
- [中文故事](https://emilkrebs.dev/zh/story/): Chinese-language story

## Facts
- Role: Software Engineer at TypeFox GmbH
- Based in: Kiel, Germany
- Focus: language servers, LSP, Langium DSLs, Theia-based IDEs, and frontends
- Education: full-time Bachelor's studies in Computer Science and Sociology at Kiel University (in progress)
- Projects: Prami (spaced-repetition learning app, in testing), VailNote (note sharing), WatchLock (phone locking from a smartwatch), Med Research MCP (scientific literature search for AI agents)
- Contact: hello@emilkrebs.dev
